statusMeaning.exact: word sequence matches a full text (case, punctuation and digits ignored); not a character-for-character claim
statusMeaning.editors-marks: same, apart from marks added by editors or compilers (citation tags, bracketed words)
statusMeaning.typo: same, apart from one recorded one-word correction applied before cutting
statusMeaning.gap: same, but the excerpt skips text with no mark; pieces spanning the skip are excluded (V14)
statusMeaning.other: differences a person must read; withheld
